column1: ROVI reported (in relevant information publication number 27397 of 12 March 2024) on the the agreement that had been
concluded with Insud Pharma S.L. and Innvierte Economía Sostenible SICC, SME, S.A. (investment company of Centro
para el Desarrollo Tecnológico Industrial EPE – CDTI) to incorporate, jointly with these two entities, a limited company
(Sociedad de responsabilidad limitada) engaged in the research and development of advanced therapies.
